assets.bodyText: A granary tally assistant counts grain measures, compares receipts, and records stores entering or leaving the granary. A checked tally begins the accounting discipline needed to manage revenue and the supply of a province.
assets.rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints

assets.title: Revenue Records Assistant
assets.subtitle: Scribe of the Nile Treasury
assets.bodyText: A revenue assistant checks receipts and records the passage of money and grain. Patient accuracy makes the treasury's figures traceable, giving its larger decisions a firmer basis than rumour, pressure, or convenient memory.
assets.rarityCharacteristics: antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners

assets.title: Grain Supply Auditor
assets.subtitle: Examiner of the Granaries
assets.bodyText: A grain auditor compares the ledger with the storehouse and questions what fails to agree. Independent scrutiny gives administration its necessary resistance, exposing the costly distance between a promising account and an empty bin.
assets.rarityCharacteristics: silver-blue, faceted gems, chamfer brackets

assets.subtitle: Keeper of the Harvest Reckoning
assets.bodyText: A senior grain steward reconciles reports from granaries, markets, and transport routes into one accountable picture. Command of the whole system makes this office a powerful guardian of Egypt's reserves and obligations.

assets.title: Nearchus
assets.subtitle: Admiral of Alexander's Fleet
assets.bodyText: Nearchus commanded Alexander's fleet from the Indus towards the Persian Gulf. His account of the difficult coastal voyage, preserved through later writers, joined practical seamanship to an enduring record of unfamiliar shores.
assets.rarityCharacteristics: amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails

assets.title: Fleet Deckhand
assets.subtitle: Crew of Nearchus' Ships
assets.bodyText: A fleet deckhand tends lines, stows gear, and answers the work of another tide. Dependable hands keep the vessel ready for orders, giving the admiral's distant destination a practical beginning on deck.
assets.rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints

assets.subtitle: Eyes Along Nearchus' Shore
assets.bodyText: A coastal scout studies headlands, landing places, and signs of fresh water ahead of the ships. Alert observation gives the fleet its next safe pause, making unfamiliar coastline a place it can approach.

assets.subtitle: Secretary and Strategist
assets.bodyText: Eumenes served Philip II and Alexander as a royal secretary before becoming a commander in the wars of the Successors. His career joined administrative skill to striking victories amid the struggle for Alexander's inheritance.

parentVariants.title: Demetrius the Besieger
parentVariants.subtitle: King of Siegecraft
parentVariants.bodyText: In this alternate history, Demetrius captured Rhodes after a campaign of siegecraft. The conquest raised the Epic Besieger to Legendary renown as the Captor of Rhodes.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: full art, gilded perimeter, radiant nameplate and figure emblem

parentVariants.title: Zeno of Citium
parentVariants.subtitle: Founder of the Stoa
parentVariants.bodyText: Teaching virtue and reason at Athens' Painted Porch, Zeno established an independently functioning Stoic school. That sustained foundation elevated the Epic teacher to Legendary renown.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: full art, gilded perimeter, radiant nameplate and figure emblem

parentVariants.title: Ptolemy I Soter
parentVariants.subtitle: Founder of a Dynasty
parentVariants.bodyText: After securing Egypt, Alexander's former general Ptolemy established an independent hereditary kingdom. Founding the Ptolemaic dynasty elevated the Epic statesman to Legendary renown.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: full art, gilded perimeter, radiant nameplate and figure emblem

parentVariants.title: Cleomenes of Naucratis
parentVariants.subtitle: Financier of Alexander's Egypt
parentVariants.bodyText: Appointed by Alexander to administer Egyptian revenue, Cleomenes became a powerful financial official. His control of grain and taxation amassed wealth, while ancient accounts also preserve accusations of ruthless exploitation and profiteering.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
